introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a centralized firewall management system for a university that manages firewall policies across academic, administrative, research, hostel, and guest networks.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should allow authorized network administrators to create, review, update, and revoke firewall rules, enforce access restrictions between network segments, monitor blocked and allowed traffic, and generate alerts for suspicious or unauthorized communication attempts.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: The platform should maintain audit logs of firewall policy changes and administrative actions, provide a dashboard for reviewing network security events, and support multiple campus buildings.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The solution should be secure, scalable, reliable, and manageable.

functional.applicability_reason: Source-backed obligations; unspecified decisions remain open.

requirements.title: provide a centralized firewall management interface to manage firewall policies across academic, administrative, research, hostel, and guest networks.
requirements.statement: The system shall provide a centralized firewall management interface to manage firewall policies across academic, administrative, research, hostel, and guest networks.

acceptance_criteria.given: A network administrator with access privileges
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator initiates policy management for the academic network segment
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall present a configuration interface for defining firewall policies specific to that segment
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the policy creation interface response

requirements.title: allow authorized network administrators to create, review, update, and revoke firewall rules, enforce access restrictions between network segments, monitor blocked and allowed traffic, and generate alerts for suspicious or unauthorized communication attempts.
requirements.statement: The system shall allow authorized network administrators to create, review, update, and revoke firewall rules, enforce access restrictions between network segments, monitor blocked and allowed traffic, and generate alerts for suspicious or unauthorized communication attempts.

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator with policy creation privileges and a test environment configured
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator creates a new rule to restrict access from hostel to research networks
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall enforce the rule and block unauthorized traffic between segments as defined
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of traffic flow before and after rule enforcement

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator with review privileges and a live network segment
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator requests to review existing firewall rules for the administrative network
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall return the current set of active rules in a readable format
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of rule response during review

acceptance_criteria.given: A network segment with abnormal traffic patterns
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects suspicious communication attempts between guest and research networks
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall generate an alert indicating unauthorized communication
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the alert notification response

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator with update privileges and a live policy in place
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator modifies a rule to allow access from academic to administrative networks
acceptance_criteria.then: The administrator modifies a rule to allow access from academic to administrative networks
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of resulting policy state

requirements.title: The platform shall maintain audit logs of firewall policy changes and administrative actions, provide a dashboard for reviewing network security events, and support multiple campus buildings.
requirements.statement: The platform shall maintain audit logs of firewall policy changes and administrative actions, provide a dashboard for reviewing network security events, and support multiple campus buildings.

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator performs a policy change on the research network segment
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall record the change in audit logs with timestamp, user ID, and action type
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of audit log entry after policy modification

acceptance_criteria.given: A network administrator accesses the security dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: The dashboard is loaded for the academic building segment
acceptance_criteria.then: The dashboard is loaded for the academic building segment

acceptance_criteria.given: A campus building with multiple network segments is configured
acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator selects the hostel building in the interface
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall present firewall policies and events specific to that building
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of segment-specific policy view for hostel

glossary.summary: Source-present terminology; definitions introduce no additional product obligation.

items.title: Policy
items.detail: A rule or decision governing permitted actions; its project-specific meaning remains defined by the source requirements.

items.title: Audit record
items.detail: A stored record of an event. Required event scope and retention are determined by the linked source, not this definition.

items.title: Log
items.detail: A collection of event records. This term does not itself require additional logging fields, events or access permissions.

items.title: Firewall
items.detail: A control that permits or restricts network traffic according to rules; mentioning it does not authorize automatic changes.

sdlc.justification: No differentiating input evidence is provided to select among Agile, DevSecOps, Spiral, V-Model, Waterfall, Hybrid, or Incremental models. All candidates receive equal suitability points (40) due to absence of factors such as budget, delivery, failure consequences, feedback, legacy, regulation, schedule, stability, uncertainty, verification. The selection is therefore provisional and subject to later evidence.
tradeoffs: Recurring delivery requires stakeholder review and backlog refinement; a cycle does not guarantee completeness or remove unresolved decisions.
